migration.description: Add durable prepared-archive recovery state, publication-kind recovery metadata, resumable archive/raw reconciliation cursors and ledgers, additive raw-capture circuit state, and bounded raw orphan admission liveness and progress evidence over the existing raw_payload_files cursor, including release-pending timestamp and idempotent evidence recovery.
migration.release_unit_description: Autonomous retention recovery, raw capture circuit breaker, and raw orphan sweep throughput.

durable_state.description: Prepared archive identity, source IDs and digest over all archive-covered columns, publication kind, artifact digest/size, bounded retry/quarantine state, prepared/legacy/raw reconciliation cursors, raw candidate identity/size/quarantine ledger with release-pending intent/timestamp and evidence-persisted marker, startup raw-path revalidation cursor, recovery-pending hysteresis marker, additive raw-capture circuit measurements including overflow-spool bytes, and raw orphan admission, settled-pass, and nonzero-removal evidence.
durable_state.storage_implementation: SQLite tables retention_prepared_archives, retention_recovery_cursors, and retention_raw_reconciliation plus additive circuit and overflow-spool columns on system_raw_payload_metrics and nullable admission/progress evidence columns on retention_recovery_cursors for the raw_payload_files scope.

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: Supported earlier v2.71.x database schemas without retention recovery tables.
source_compatibility_range.to_program_version: Candidate based on mainline v2.74.6 at base commit 97ccccc6bd2e0e2f5dac0def8fa59d91203b2f6d.

ddl_structural_changes.description: Idempotently create retention_prepared_archives with publication_kind, its path/due-work indexes, retention_recovery_cursors with prepared/legacy/raw scopes and retry/progress columns, ensure nullable raw_payload_files admission/settled-pass/removal evidence columns on that existing cursor table, create retention_raw_reconciliation with release-pending intent/timestamp, evidence-persisted marker, and bounded due-work index, and add raw-capture circuit plus overflow-spool columns on system_raw_payload_metrics.

dml_changes.description: Insert and update only bounded prepared archive, retry, raw quarantine, and cursor rows during normal maintenance.
Confirm raw ownership from the existing indexed blob-link ledger inside the source transaction before post-commit physical unlink; no new schema object or archive format is introduced.

Persist raw orphan worker retry deadline, failure count/fingerprint, defer reason, progress, fixed admission stage/cause, most recent settled-pass counters/completeness, and most recent nonzero-removal count/bytes through the raw_payload_files cursor row; release evidence is committed with an idempotent per-ledger-row persisted marker, and nullable evidence is written only when observed.

historical_data_backfill_or_transformati.description: No startup-wide historical backfill and no evidence backfill for older cursor rows; NULL admission/progress evidence remains unknown. Legacy archive reconciliation advances at most 32 archive files, raw residual reconciliation advances at most 128 directory entries and at most 32 supported files per slice, and raw inventory advances at most 128 DB references per maintenance pass.

progress_signals: retentionRecovery prepared/quarantined/backlog counts, stage, last progress, next retry, and failure fingerprint
rawCapture state/reason, physical raw bytes, filesystem available bytes, fixed close/recovery watermarks, bounded reservations, and backlog trend
rawOrphanSweep state, per-slice counts/bytes, admission stage/cause, last progress, retry time, defer reason, sanitized failure fingerprint, settled-pass evidence, and most recent nonzero removal
pause_points: Between idempotent schema creation and maintenance-owned ledger writes.
Between each maintenance pass of at most 32 legacy archive files, 128 raw directory entries / 32 raw residual files, and 128 raw inventory references.

recovery.program_rollback_state_behavior: Earlier binaries can open the additive recovery schema and ignore the new columns, but a rollback while a release-pending raw row is active is not evidence-preserving: legacy missing-row cleanup may clear that row before a newer binary can recover its evidence. The reused raw_payload_files cursor remains a filename key that older scanners can safely tail-wrap past.
recovery.faulty_release_recovery: A newer program version resumes or forward-repairs retained journal rows and quarantined artifacts when the release-pending row survives; NULL raw orphan evidence is treated as unknown and is populated only by later observations, while a release-pending raw ledger row remains eligible for evidence recovery even after the directory cursor advances. Present pending rows rotate their due-work timestamp, and a present identity replacement resets observation without claiming removal evidence for the older object. Pending evidence recovery is forward-only across a rollback to legacy retention cleanup.

required_test_evidence: Public system-status API additions remain compatible within the current Major, while persistent-state impact is minor because legacy rollback cleanup cannot preserve an active release-pending removal-evidence row.

Candidate reads and writes supported earlier-Minor state, including cursor and raw reconciliation rows without the new nullable evidence columns; NULL evidence remains unknown until a newer binary observes it.
Earlier-Minor programs are not required to read newly migrated state, and pending-evidence recovery is explicitly forward-only across rollback to legacy retention cleanup.
A forward-repair version handles state left by a stopped faulty release, including idempotent evidence persistence after physical unlink and ledger-cleanup failure.

The final current-tree shared-testbox profiles recorded archive-file-io 298/298 and stateful-sqlite 1341/1341 (two slow tests, 1499 skipped). Focused checks recorded raw_orphan_sweep 13, cold_compression 6, retention_raw_reconciliation 4, the idempotent schema migration test 1, and direct raw payload storage tests 3.
Current program upgrades and uses state from the immediately preceding Major.
Direct major skipping is rejected or routed through an explicit intermediate upgrade.
A forward-repair version handles state left by a stopped faulty release.
